publicRowPredicates.posts: deleted = false AND hidden = false AND COALESCE(visibility, 'public') = 'public' AND status <> 'pending_review'
publicRowPredicates.comments: deleted = false AND hidden = false AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.posts p WHERE p.id = comments.post_id AND p.deleted = false AND p.hidden = false AND COALESCE(p.visibility, 'public') = 'public' AND p.status <> 'pending_review')
